fit.rank_scope: diagnostic; collinearity does not justify replacing cases

declaration.policy: reference configuration 27; BF16 storage, FP32 reductions
declaration.timing_boundary: scheduled arrival through completed trace drain; resident weights, initialization and warmup outside measured trace
declaration.telemetry: schedule/build/execute/postprocess host durations; execute includes upload, GPU submission, synchronization and selected-token readback
declaration.numerical_policy: configuration 27 throughout; exact generated histories across budgets and repeats
declaration.admission: one explicitly selected policy, identical across every cell
declaration.observation: complete existing steps/events; KV occupancy observation disabled
declaration.request_scope: finite traces without aborts; exact own-route histories and complete pool drain
declaration.calibration: fresh same-build calibration on a different canonical native workload; embedded archive reproduces NNLS coefficients and residuals
declaration.pairing: same binary, assets, trace, workspace and admission; fixed256 control and self-control; forward/reverse/reverse/forward block order

statistic_scope: per-run quantiles then four-block medians; online descriptive; offline paired self-noise verdict
time_scope: synchronous execute duration includes host launch and device synchronization, not isolated GPU time
queue_scope: sampled step-boundary waiting/free blocks; no admission-delay or unused-memory integration
